descriptionMarkdown:
Uses the Cybersyn mod, so trains are set and forget. You can also run it with your own train logic, for example interrupts or circuits.

The book gives you simple, common blocks for the basics. Everything is made to be easy to set up, so building your own blocks on top of it is quick.

📷 See all pictures and clips

Features

  • [item=rail] No deadlocks: everything is chunk-aligned, and trains wait at their stations, outside the main network.
  • [item=rail] Two rail pieces: a straight and a roundabout cover any layout. The roundabout can be rotated and pasted over itself for 2, 3 or 4 directions.
  • [item=rail-ramp] Elevated rails: both pieces also exist elevated, with a ramp to switch between ground and elevated rails.
  • [item=cargo-wagon] 2-wagon trains: enough for everything here, since Space Age needs fewer materials than vanilla.
  • [item=roboport] Your own blocks: the stations and layouts can be reused for them, and roboports cover every block.
  • [item=big-electric-pole] Rail variants: rails only, or rails and power only, for example to keep logistic networks apart or for Fulgora.

Blocks

  • [item=automation-science-pack] Science: red and green, military, blue, purple and yellow, plus labs and biolabs.
  • [item=iron-plate] Smelting: steel furnace smelter, foundries and molten ores.
  • [item=processing-unit] Circuits: green, red and blue circuits in early, mid and late-game versions.
  • [item=steam-turbine] Power: 60 MW steam, 480 MW heating towers (both burn whatever fuel you request) and 3.4 GW fusion.
  • [fluid=petroleum-gas] Fluids: oil refining and sulfuric acid.
  • [item=rocket-silo] Rockets: rocket fuel, low density structures, silos and space platform foundations.
  • [space-location=vulcanus] Vulcanus: molten ores, oil, tungsten carbide, refined concrete and 550 MW or 1.4 GW of steam.
  • [item=biter-egg] Nauvis: biter egg silos and captive spawners.
  • [item=artillery-turret] Defenses: artillery outposts to push biters out of your pollution cloud, plus laser and tesla defenses for rail intersections.
  • [item=electric-engine-unit] Also: artillery shells, electric engines, refined concrete, and removers for blocks, stations and chunks.

Notes
[item=train-stop] Cybersyn needs at least one depot and a refuel station before it can dispatch trains. The 10 Depots + Fuel Station print has both, ready to paste.

Release notes

2026-11-03: Fixes

  • Fixed 10 Depots + Fuel Station: the train stops had no names, so the depots didn't work. They are now named Depot and Fuel Station.
  • Fixed City blocks: cleanup, input stations are now set to requester instead of auto, so turning off a request no longer makes the station a provider. Existing blocks are unaffected.
  • Fixed Network Requester: now counts what your whole logistics network holds (with its own roboport), not only its chests.
  • Fixed Network Provider: train limit set to 1, so only one train comes at a time.

2026-11-02: Factorio 2.1 update

  • Breaking Foundries: new melting logic, pick only the casting recipe. Existing blocks are unaffected.
  • New 10 Depots + Fuel Station: the 10 depots with a Cybersyn refuel station, as an example.
  • New Network Requester: requests several items by train and puts them into your logistics network.
  • New 60MW: steam power that burns whatever fuel you set in its requests.
  • New Vulcanus Refined Concrete: fed with lava through the bottom-left pipe, with a free spot for a requester station.
title: T-nm's Trains (Chunk Aligned City Blocks)
